title: Late Cancellation Penalty Owed and Excess Kept — Room Reservations Computation Standard
content:
## Standard

**Penalty owed.** The penalty a late cancellation of a Room Reservations reservation owes is the penalty night the plan's late-cancellation basis gives, that is one night at the nightly rate on the reservation where the basis is the first night and every night of the stay where it is the full stay, with room tax added at the hotel's tax rate where the plan adds tax to penalties. Room tax is added last, on the penalty night, and the penalty owed is rounded to the cent before the amount reversed is worked out.

**Penalty charged.** The penalty charged is every late cancellation penalty on the reservation less every reversal already posted against it, as the reservation's charge records show.

**Amount reversed.** The amount reversed is the penalty charged less the penalty a late cancellation owes rounded to the cent, never below zero and never above the penalty charged.

The plan figures read are the plan's late cancellation basis and whether the plan adds tax to a cash penalty, as each rate plan lists them in the penalty basis tariff; the nightly rate, nights and tax rate are those on the reservation.

## Worked computations (hypothetical reservations)

**Flexible Rate, 4 nights at 220.00, tax 12.5%, penalty charged 990.00.**
The plan's basis is the first night and the plan adds tax: the penalty night is 220.00; with 12.5% tax the penalty owed is 247.50. The amount reversed is 990.00 less 247.50, that is 742.50.

**Same reservation, a reversal of 500.00 already posted.**
The penalty charged is 990.00 less 500.00, that is 490.00. The amount reversed is 490.00 less 247.50, that is 242.50.

**Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate, 3 nights at 180.00, tax 14%, penalty charged 615.60.**
The basis is the full stay: the penalty night is 3 nights at 180.00, that is 540.00; with 14% tax, 615.60. The amount reversed is 615.60 less 615.60, that is 0.00 — nothing is reversed.

| Penalty charged | Penalty owed | Amount reversed |
|---|---|---|
| 990.00 | 247.50 | 742.50 |
| 247.50 | 247.50 | 0.00 |
| 200.00 | 247.50 | 0.00 — never below zero |
